name.value: Blue Cedars RV Park and Campground

description.value: A full-service private campground in a Douglas-fir forest on the western edge of Prince George, with direct trailhead access to the 25 km Cranbrook Hill Greenway; open year-round with showers, laundry, and WiFi, though tent rates are steep for an RV-focused park.

address.value: 4433 Kimball Rd, Prince George, BC V2N 5N7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is an operational RV park and campground at 4433 Kimball Rd, Prince George, with tent sites, showers, laundry, free WiFi, a convenience store, and direct trail access to the 25 km Cranbrook Hill Greenway (explicitly used by cyclists). The rates page confirms potable water in the tenting area, online booking, and proximity to restaurants and shops. The site was last modified July 2022 and still displays a COVID-era notice, suggesting the website is not actively maintained, though the business claims to be open year-round.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Campground with tent sites, showers, laundry, water, and a convenience store, located directly on the Cranbrook Hill Greenway cycling trail. Strong fit for touring cyclists passing through Prince George.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free WiFi available throughout the park. Pet friendly (dogs on leash, max 2). Also offers bunk house cabins and RV rentals. Open all year per website. Accepts Visa, Mastercard, Interac.
